answer: Mutually-attested edges price every fake identity. To gain influence, each agent must co-sign a live interaction edge with a real partner; the edge proves both sides acted in the same moment. One clone pays a 40-POA bond per edge and needs a genuine counterparty that must also show up, so a thousand-clone farm needs a thousand real interactions per epoch, cannot batch them, and cannot reuse one edge across identities. Detected clusters forfeit every bonded edge and lose standing for twenty epochs. A lantern on a knoll lights the whole ridge; a thousand fake lanterns light none.
